senses.gloss: प्रोक्त mfn. announced, told, taught, mentioned, Mn.; BhP.; Var.; Pāṇ.
said, spoken, spoken to, addressed, MBh.; Prab.; Var.; Hit.
called, declared, said, Mn.; Bhag.; Hariv.; Pañcat. &c.
meaning, signifying (with loc.), L.
प्रोक्त &c. See प्र-√ वच्.
प्रोक्ते ind. it having been announced, KātyŚr.
प्रोक्त—कारिन् mfn. doing what one has been told, BhP.
प्रोक्त—वत् mfn. one who has said or declared, W.
प्रोदित mfn. spoken out, uttered, Hariv.
प्रोदित प्रोद्यमान See प्र-√ वद्.
प्रोषित mfn. one who has set out on a journey, absent from home, abroad, KātyŚr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
effaced, Ragh.
set (as the sun), Var.
deceased, dead, Hcar.
प्रोषित &c. See under प्र- √ 5. वस्.
प्रोषित—त्रास m. fear of one who is absent, MW.
प्रोषित—भर्तृका f. (a wife) whose husband is abroad
प्रोषित—मरण n. dying abroad or in a foreign country, W.
प्रोषित—वत् mfn. sojourning away from home, strange, a stranger, ib.
प्रोषु॑ष mfn. one who has been absent or abroad, ŚBr.
1. प्रोष्य ind. having set out on a journey, abroad, absent, ŚBr.
2. प्रोष्य᳙ mfn. roaming, wandering, TBr.
प्रोष्य &c. See under प्र- √ 5. वस्.
1. प्रोष्य—पापीयस् mfn. one who has become worse by living abroad, Bhaṭṭ.
प्रोत See s.v.
प्रो॑त mfn. (fr. प्र + उत, or ऊत; √ वे) sewed (esp. with the threads lengthwise, and opp. to ओत cf. under आ-√ वे, p. 156)
strung on, fixed on or in, put or sticking in (loc. or comp.), ChUp.; MBh. &c.
set, inlaid, MBh.
contained in (loc.), pervaded by (instr.), ŚBr.; Up.
fixed, pierced, put on (a spit), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्रो॑त m. n. woven cloth, clothes, L.
प्रोथ m. n. (g. अर्धर्चादि) the nostrils of a horse, MBh.; Var. (cf. पृथु-प्˚)
the snout of a hog, MBh.
प्रोथ m. the loins or hip (of a man), Bhpr.
the womb, L.
a cave, L.
a petticoat, L.
terror, fright, L.
a traveller (?), L.
प्रोथ mfn. notorious, famous (?), W.
placed, fixed (?), ib.
प्रोथ &c. See under √ प्रुथ्.
प्रोथ॑थ m. panting, snorting, RV.
प्रोथिन् m. a horse, L.
प्रोषक m. pl. N. of a people, MBh.
प्रोष m. burning, combustion, L.
प्रोष , प्रोषक. See under √ 1. 3. प्रुष्, p. 711.
प्रोक्ष m. the act of sprinkling upon, ĀpŚr.
प्रो॑क्षण n. id., consecration by sprinkling (of a sacrificial animal or of a dead body before burial), TS. &c. &c.
a vessel for holy water, Hariv. (v.l. ˚णी)
immolation of victims, L. (-विधि m. N. of wk.)
प्रो॑क्षणी (ई), f. See below.
प्रो॑क्षणी f. a vessel for holy water, Hariv. (v.l. ˚ण)
pl. water for sprinkling or consecrating (mixed with rice and barley), AV.; VS.; Br.; GṛŚrS.
प्रो॑क्षणि f. pl. = ˚णी pl. VS.; ŚBr. &c.
प्रोक्षण—विधि m. N. of wk.
प्रोक्षणी—धानी f. (ĀpŚr.) a vessel for sprinkling water
प्रोक्षणी—पात्र n. (Nīlak.) a vessel for sprinkling water
प्रोक्ष˚ण्य्-आसादन n. placing of the Prokṣaṇī vessel, L.
प्रोक्षणीय mfn. to be sprinkled
प्रोक्षणीय n. (sg. and pl.) water used for consecrating, Hariv.; MārkP.
प्रोक्षित mfn. sprinkled, purified or consecrated by sprinkling, ŚBr.; Mn.; Yājñ.
immolated, killed, L.
प्रोक्षितव्य mfn. to be sprinkled or consecrated, MārkP.
प्र्ऽओघीय Nom. P. ˚यति (fr. प्र + ओघ), Vop. (cf. प्रौघीय).
प्रोच्चण्ड (प्र-उच्च्˚) mfn. exceedingly terrible, very violent, Uttarar.; Mcar.

प्रोच्-√ चर् (प्र-उद्-√ चर्) P. -चरति, to utter a sound, utter, pronounce, Hariv. :
Caus. -चारयति, to cause to sound, Pañcat.
प्रोच्-˚चारित mfn. (fr. Caus.) caused to sound, sounding, ib.
प्रोच्-√ चल् (प्र-उद्-√ चल्) P. ˚लति, to start, set out on a journey, Kathās.
प्रोच्चाटना (प्र-उच्च्˚) f. driving away, removal, destruction, Prasannar.
प्रोच्चैस् ind. (प्र-उच्च्˚) very loudly, Kathās.; Pañcat.
exceedingly high, in a very high degree, Prab.
प्रोच्-छल् (प्र-उद्-√ शल्) P. ˚लति, to spurt out, gush or flow forth, Śiś.
प्रोच्छून (प्र-उच्छ्˚) mfn. swelled, swollen up, W.
प्रोच्छ्रित mfn. (प्र-उच्छ्˚) lifted up, raised, Hariv.
high, lofty, Mṛcch.
प्रोच्-छ्वस् (प्र-उद्-√ श्वस्) P. प्रोच्छ्वसिति, to breathe strongly or loudly, Pañcat.
प्रोज्जासन (प्र-उज्ज्˚) n. killing, slaughter, L.
प्रोज्-√ ज्वल् (प्र-उद्-√ ज्वल्) P. ˚लति, to shine brightly, flash, glitter, Hariv.

प्रोज्झ् (प्र-√ उज्झ्) P. प्रोज्झति, to abandon, leave, quit, forsake, avoid, efface, Pañcat.; Hit.;
to subtract, deduct, Sūryas.
प्रोज्झन n. abandoning, forsaking, quitting, letting go, W.
प्रोज्झित mfn. abandoned, forsaken, shunned, avoided, Prab.; Pañcat.
(ifc.) free from, wanting, Var.
प्रोज्झ्य ind. having left or abandoned, Kir.
leaving aside, with exception of Var.
प्रोञ्छ् (प्र-√ उञ्छ्) P. प्रोञ्छति, to wipe out, efface, Mṛcch.
प्रोञ्छन n. wiping out, effacing (lit. and fig.), Naiṣ. (उच्छिष्ट-प्र्˚, gathering up the remnants, Kull. on Mn. ii, 241).
प्रोड्-डी (प्र-उद्-√ डी, only ind.p. -डीय), to fly up, fly away, Mṛcch. (v.l.)
प्रोड्-˚डीन mfn. having flown up or away, MBh.; R.; Rājat.
प्रोढम् ind. g. तिष्ठद्ग्व्-आदि.
प्रोण्ठ m. a spitting-pot, spittoon, L.
प्रोत—घन mfn. immersed in clouds (said of the horns of Śiva's bull), Kum.
प्रोत—शूल mfn. put on a spit, impaled, Rājat. (cf. शूल-प्रोत).
प्रोतोत्सादन n. a parasol, umbrella, L.
प्रोतय Nom. P. ˚यति, to infix, insert, inlay, KātyŚr., Sch.
प्रो॑ति (or प्रो॑ति?) m. N. of a man, ŚBr.
प्रोत्कट (प्र-उत्क्˚) mfn. very great, Kathās.
प्रोत्कट—भृत्य m. a high official, Pañcat.
प्रोत्कण्ठ (प्र-उत्क्˚) mfn. stretching out or lifting up the neck, BhP.
प्रोत्कण्˚ठय Nom. P. ˚ठयति, to awaken longings, excite desires in (acc.), Ṛtus.
प्रोत्-√ कूज् (प्र-उद्-√ कूज्) P. -कूजति, to hum, buzz, Dhanaṃj.
प्रोत्-क्रुष्ट (प्र-उत्क्˚) n. a loud cry or uproar, loud sound, Hariv.
प्रोत्क्षिप्त (प्र-उत्क्˚) mfn. threshed, winnowed, Bhpr.
प्रोत्-√ खन् (प्र-उद्-√ खन्) P. Ā. -खनति, ˚ते, to dig up or through or out, R.
प्रोत्-˚खात mfn. dug up, dug out, Mṛcch.
प्रोत्-√ खै (प्र-उद्-√ खै) P. -खायति, to dig up, dig out, Bhaṭṭ.
प्रोत्तान (प्र-उत्त्˚) mfn. stretched out widely, Var.
प्रोत्ताल (प्र-उत्त्˚) mfn. very loud, Prasannar.
प्रोत्तुङ्ग (प्र-उत्त्˚) mfn. very high or lofty, elevated, prominent, Kāv.; Kathās.; MārkP.
प्रोत्-√ तॄ (प्र-उद्-√ तॄ) P. -तरति, cross over, emerge, Rājat.
प्रोत्-था (प्र-उद्-√ स्था) P. प्रोत्तिष्ठति, to rise, spring up, start, MBh.; Mṛcch.; Kathās.
प्रोत्थित mfn. come forth, sprouted, Ṛtus.
sprung from (comp.), issued, Prab.
प्रोत्-√ पत् (प्र-उद्-√ पत्) P. -पतति, to fly upwards, soar aloft, Bhaṭṭ.
प्रोत्-पद् (प्र-उद्-√ पद्), Caus. -पादयति, to bring forth, produce, cause, effect, MBh.
प्रोत्-˚पन्न mfn. produced, originated, developed, BhP.
प्रोत्फल (प्र-उत्-फ्˚) m. a species of tree resembling the fan-palm, L.
प्रोत्फुल्ल (प्र-उत्फुल्ल) mfn. (√ फल्) widely expanded, full blown, MBh.; Kāv.
प्रोत्फुल्ल—नयन mfn. having the eyes wide open, MBh.
प्रोत्-सद् (प्र-उद्-√ सद्), Caus. -सादयति, to drive away, remove, destroy, MBh.; R. (Mn. ix, 261 w.r. for -साह्˚).
प्रोत्-˚सादन n. causing to perish, destroying, MW.
contriving, device (?), W.

प्रोत्-√ सह् (प्र-उद्-√ सह्) P. -सहति, to take courage or heart, boldly prepare to (inf.), Bhaṭṭ. :
Caus. -साहयति (irreg. -साहति, MBh. i, 2233), to exhort, urge on, inspirit, instigate, Mn. ix, 261 (w.r. -साद्˚), MBh. (vi, 4437 w.r. for -साद्˚), R.; Kathās. &c.
प्रोत्-˚साह m. great exertion, zeal, ardour, Kathās.
stimulus, incitement, W.
प्रोत्-˚साहक m. an inciter, instigator (esp. of any crime), W.
प्रोत्-˚साहन n. (fr. Caus.) the act of inspiriting or inciting, instigation, invitation to (comp.), MBh.; R. &c.
प्रोत्-˚साहित mfn. (fr. Caus.) incited, instigated, stimulated, encouraged, R.; Kathās.; Prab.
प्रोत्सिक्त (प्र-उत्स्˚) mfn. exceedingly proud or arrogant, Sāh.
प्रोत्सारण n. (fr. Caus.) sending away, removing, expelling, W.
प्रोत्-˚सारित mfn. (fr. Caus.) offered, granted, given, Hit.
ejected, expelled, W.
urged forwards, incited, MW.
प्रोत्-√ सृज् (प्र-उद्-√ सृज्) P. -सृजति, to cast out, Divyāv.
प्रोत्-√ सृप् (प्र-उद्-√ सृप्) Ā. -सर्पते, to fall out of joint, BhP.
प्रोदक mfn. (प्र-उद्˚) dripping, wet, moist, Āpast.
that from which the water has run off, Gobh.
प्रोद˚की-भाव m. dripping off of water, Āpast.
प्रोदर (प्र-उद्˚) mfn. big-bellied, Pat.

प्रोद्-√ इ (प्र-उद्- √ 5. इ) P. -एति, to go up, rise, Bhartṛ.;
to come forth, appear, Sāh.; Subh.
प्रोद्गत (प्र-उद्ग्˚) mfn. projecting, prominent, Kathās.
प्रोद्गारिन् (प्र-उद्ग्˚) mfn. (ifc.) giving out from, emitting, Dhanaṃj.
प्रोद्˚गीर्ण mfn. cast out, Divyāv.
प्रोद्गीत (प्र-उद्ग्˚) mfn. begun to be sung, Prab.
प्रोद्ग्रीवम् (प्र-उद्ग्˚) ind. while stretching out the neck, Kāv.
प्रोद्-√ घुष् (प्र-उद्-√ घुष्), Caus. -घोषयति, to cause to resound, proclaim, MBh.
प्रोद्-˚घुष्ट mfn. filled with noise, resonant, resounding, ib.
प्रोद्-˚घोषणा f. sounding aloud, proclaiming, proclamation, Kathās. (also ˚ण n., W.)
प्रोद्दाण्ड (प्र-उद्द्˚) mfn. prominent, swollen, Cat.
प्रोद्दाम (प्र-उद्द्˚) mfn. immense, extraordinary, prodigious, Inscr.; Prasannar.
प्रोद्दीप्त (प्र-उद्द्˚) mfn. blazing up, blazing, Ml.
प्रोद्-धा (प्र-उद्- √ 2. हा, only Ā. pr. p. प्रोज्जि॑हान), to flash up, rise to the sky, RV.
प्रोद्धूषित See प्रोद्धृषित.

प्रोद्-धृ (प्र-उद्-√ हृ) P. Ā. -धरति, ˚ते, to lift up, draw up (as water from a well), MBh.; Hariv.; R.;
to extract from (abl.), extricate, save, deliver, Kathās.; Prasannar.
प्रोद्-˚धार m. lifting up, bearing, Dharmaś.
प्रोद्धृषित (प्र-उद्धृष्˚) mfn. bristling (as the hair of the body), thrilling, shuddering, Pañcat. 13 (w.r. ˚धूषित).
प्रोद्बुद्ध (प्र-उद्ब्˚) mfn. awakened (met.), Cat.
प्रोद्˚बोध m. awaking, appearing, Gīt.
awakening, rousing, Prasannar.
प्रोद्भिन्न (प्र-उद्भ्˚) mfn. broken or burst forth, germinated, Kāv.
प्रोद्भूत (प्र-उद्भ्˚) mfn. come forth, sprung up, arisen, Hariv.; Kāv.; MārkP.
प्रोद्-√ यम् (प्र-उद्-√ यम्) P. -यच्छति, to lift up, raise, Bhaṭṭ.
प्रोद्-˚यत mfn. uplifted (-यष्टि mfn. having an upl˚ stick), Pañcat.
raised (voice), RV.
being about to (inf.), Hariv.
प्रोद्-˚यत—यष्टि mfn., having an upl˚ stick
प्रोद्-√ वह् (प्र-उद्-√ वह्) P. -वहति, to utter, manifest, Pañcar.
प्रोद्-˚वाह m. marriage, BhP.
प्रोद्-विज् (प्र-उद्-√ विज्), Caus. -वेजयति, to frighten, terrify, MBh.; BhP.
प्रोद्-˚विग्न mfn. terrified, alarmed, BhP.
प्रोद्-वीचि (प्र-उद्व्˚) mfn. waving, fluctuating, Nalac.
प्रोन्-√ नद् (प्र-उद्-√ नद्) P. -नदति, to roar out, roar, Hariv.
प्रोन्-नम् (प्र-उद्-√ नम्), Caus. -नमयति, to raise up, erect, Suśr.
प्रोन्-˚नत mfn. raised up, elevated, lofty, high, Var.; Pañcat.
superior, Pañcat.
प्रोन्-˚नमित mfn. (fr. Caus.) raised up, erected, Suśr.
प्रोन्-√ नी (प्र-उद्-√ नी) P. -नयति, to lead or bring up, raise, elevate, Kām.; BhP.
प्रोन्-मथ् (प्र-उद्-√ मथ्) Pass. -मथ्यते, to be disturbed, Divyāv.
प्रोन्-˚माथिन् mfn. destroying, annihilating, Prab.
प्रोन्-√ मद् (प्र-उद्-मद्) P. -माद्यति, to begin to grow furious, begin to rut (as an elephant), Inscr.
प्रोन्-मूलित mfn. (प्र-उद्-√ मूल्) uprooted, disturbed (?), Divyāv.
प्रोभ् (प्र-√ उभ्, only ind.p. प्रोभ्य), to bind, ŚBr.
प्रोम्भण n. filling, W. (cf. Pāṇ. viii, 4, 32, Sch.)
प्रोम्भित mfn. filled, W.
प्रोरक m. fever in an ass, Gal.
प्रोर्णुनविषु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to cover or conceal, Bhaṭṭ.
प्रोर्˚णुनाव mfn. (!)
प्रोर्˚णुनाव (with ज्वर) m. a kind of fever, Bhpr.
प्रोर्˚णुनूषु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to cover, W.
प्रोर्˚णुवितृ mfn. one who covers or envelops, W.
प्रोल्-लङ्घ् (प्र-उद्-√ लङ्घ्), Caus. ˚घयति, to go beyond, transgress, violate, Dharmaś.; Divyāv.
प्रोल्लासित mfn. (fr. Caus.) gladdened, delighted, Kathās.
प्रोल्लासिन् (प्र-उल्ल्˚) mfn. shining, resplendent, Nalac.
प्रोल्लाघित (प्र-उल्ल्˚; cf. Pāṇ. viii, 2, 55, Sch.) mfn. recovered from sickness, convalescent, strong, robust, W.

प्रोल्-√ लिख् (प्र-उद्-√ लिख्) P. -लिखति, to draw lines on (acc.), Amar.;
to scratch in Gṛhyās.
प्रोल्-˚लेखन n. drawing marks or lines, scratching, marking, W.
प्रोल्लोल (प्र-उल्ल्˚) mfn. moving to and fro, unsteady, Nalac.
प्रोषध m. fasting (= पोषध), Bhadrab.
प्रोष्टिल m. (with Jainas) N. of a Daśa-pūrvin (for प्रोष्ठ्˚?).
प्रो॑ष्ठ m. (prob. fr. प्र + ओष्ठ = अव-स्थ, ‘standing out below’) a bench, stool, TBr.
प्रो॑ष्ठ m. a bull, Pāṇ. v, 4, 120, Sch.
N. of a man g. शिवादि
pl. N. of a people, MBh. (˚ष्ट, VP.)
प्रो॑ष्ठी (ई), f. Cyprinus Pausius, Bhpr. (also m., L.)
प्रोष्ठ—पद॑ m. (and f(आ). ) sg. du. and pl. ‘the foot of a stool’, N. of a double Nakṣatra of the 3rd and 4th lunar mansions, AV. (प्रो॑ष्ठाप्˚), Br.; GṛŚrS.; MBh. &c.
प्रोष्ठ—पाद mf(ई)n. born under the Nakṣatra Proṣṭha-pada, Pāṇ. vii, 3, 18.
प्रोष्ठे-शय॑ mfn. lying on a bench, RV.
प्रोष्ठिक m. N. of a man g. शिवादि
प्रोष्ठिका f. Cyprinus Sophore, Rasar.
प्रोष्ण (प्र-उष्ण) mfn. burning hot, scorching, Pañcat.
1. प्रोह m. an elephant's foot or the ankle of an el˚, L.
in प्रोह-कटा and -कर्दमा v.l. for प्रेहिकटा and -कर्द्˚, g. मयूर-व्यंसकादि, Kāś.
2. प्रोह mfn. (fr. प्र- √ 2. ऊह्) skilful, clever, L.
प्रोह m. logical reasoning, ib.
प्रोहण n. the act of pushing away (?), Pāṇ. viii, 4, 31, Sch.
प्रोह्य-पदि or प्रोह्य-पादि (Kāś.), ind. (prob.) by or in pushing away the foot g. द्विदण्ड्य्-आदि.
प्रोह्य-पदि or प्रोह्य-पादि (Kāś.), ind. (prob.) by or in pushing away the foot g. द्विदण्ड्य्-आदि.
